(FOR D1B WE KNOW HOW MANY VOTERS CAME IN (CHECKED-IN) AND VOTED EARLY IN-PERSON (209,266) REGARDLESS IF IT COUNTED OR NOT, AS THE D1B ASKS FOR. HOWEVER, IN F1F IT ASKS “F1F. VOTERS WHO CAST A BALLOT AT AN IN-PERSON EARLY VOTING LOCATION, AND WHOSE BALLOTS WERE COUNTED”. WE EXPLAINED IN THE COMMENTS FOR F1F THAT “FOR MARICOPA, VOTERS WHO VOTE "EARLY" ARE ALL CATEGORIZED AS EARLY VOTERS AND REGARDLESS IF THEY VOTED BY EARLY BY MAIL OR EARLY IN-PERSON, THE CAST TOTAL SHOWN IN OUR CANVASS IS A COMBINED "EARLY VOTING" TOTAL. AS SUCH, F1D CONTAINS THE TOTAL OF VOTERS WHO CAST AN EARLY IN-PERSON BALLOT.)

source_details.f13: IT WAS DIFFICULT AND TOOK GREAT EFFORT TO ADAPT ON SUCH A SHORT TIMELINE TO THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC AND TO COMBAT WIDESPREAD MISINFORMATION AND DISINFORMATION CAMPAIGNS.  THANKFULLY, WE WERE ABLE TO FOCUS OUR RESOURCES BY CONDUCTING THE ELECTION BY MAIL BALLOT.  A RECORD NUMBER OF BALLOTS WERE CAST.  ELECTORS HAD THE OPTION OF VOTING WITH OR WITHOUT IN-PERSON CONTACT, AND IN-PERSON BUSINESS WAS CONDUCTED IN ACCORDANCE WITH PUBLIC HEALTH GUIDELINES.  SB 162, THE BILL THAT ALLOWED US TO BEGIN REMOVING BALLOTS FROM ENVELOPES AND TABULATE EARLY, WAS KEY TO OUR ELECTION NIGHT REPORTING SUCCESS.  ANOTHER LINCHPIN IN READJUSTING AND MEETING OUR GOALS WAS THE CTCL GRANT AND THE COUNTY APPLIED FOR AN RECEIVED.  THE GRANT WAS USED TO PURCHASE MATERIALS AND ADD STAFF TO ADAPT TO CONDUCTING THE ELECTION IN A PANDEMIC ENVIRONMENT, AND TO EDUCATE THE PUBLIC ABOUT VOTING OPTIONS.

source_details.f13: ACTUALLY PROCESS-WISE EVERYTHING WENT VERY SMOOTHLY.  MOST OF OUR ISSUES HAD TO DO WITH VOTER INQUIRIES REGARDING THE MAIL ONLY BALLOT AND WHAT THEY SAW OR READ ON SOCIAL MEDIA AND EQUATING OTHER STATES’ PROCEDURES AND ISSUES  WITH NEBRASKA.  OUR VOTERS, WHILE VERY HAPPY WITH MAIL ONLY BALLOTS IN THE PRIMARY DUE TO COVID-19, WEREN’T SO RECEPTIVE TO THEM IN THE GENERAL BECAUSE OF ALL THE RHETORIC OUT THERE REGARDING FRAUD WITH MAIL OUT BALLOTS.

OUR BIGGEST PROBLEM WAS GETTING POLL WORKERS AND GETTING THEM TRAINED. WOULD BE NICE IF ALL OF NEBRASKA COULD BE A VOTE BY MAIL STATE OR AT LEAST LET THE COUNTIES DECIDE. OVERALL, OUR ELECTION WENT VERY WELL AND I HAD SO MANY WONDERFUL PEOPLE STEP UP TO HELP.

IT IS CONCERNING WHEN WE REALIZE THAT A MAJORITY OF MY POLL WORKERS ARE 61 YEARS AND OLDER.  IT IS DIFFICULT TO GET THE YOUNGER PEOPLE TO SERVE BECAUSE THEY ALL WORK; FAMILIES CONSIST OF TWO WORKING PARENTS THIS DAY AND AGE.  I DO BELIEVE IT WILL GET MORE DIFFICULT IN THE COMING YEARS TO GET MY POLLS STAFFED.  I BELIEVE THE NUMBERS SPEAK FOR THEMSELVES AND WE NEED TO CONSIDER NAVIGATING TOWARD ELECTIONS BEING HELD BY MAIL.  WE NEED LESS STAFFING TO CARRY OUT AN ELECTION VIA MAIL; IF WE RAN ELECTIONS BY MAIL WE DO NOT HAVE TO RELY ON THE TWO PERSON WORKING FAMILIES (THAT WE CANNOT GET TO HELP US).
HOWEVER, BEFORE WE CAN NAVIGATE TO A MAIL VOTING SYSTEM, WE HAVE TO HELP OUR SOCIETY TRUST IN THE MAIL SYSTEM AGAIN.  AMERICA HAS BEEN USING OUR “MAIL SYSTEM” SINCE THE PONY EXPRESS, IT IS A RELIABLE INSTITUTION AND WE SHOULD NOT BE AFRAID TO USE IT.  THERE IS WORK TO BE DONE, BUT WE CAN SUCCESSFULLY SERVE OUR CITIZEN THROUGH THE USE OF THEIR FEDERAL POSTAL SYSTEMS.
ONLY PROBLEM WE HAD WAS ONE OF THE VILLAGES ANNEXED IN A HOUSING DEVELOPMENT AND DID NOT SHARE THAT INFORMATION WITH US.

source_details.f13:
USPS RELOCATED THE DISTRIBUTION CENTER TO OMAHA FROM GRAND ISLAND AND NOT ALL VOTERS ARE AWARE OF THE LONGER DELIVERY TIME. OUR LOCAL POST OFFICE OFFICIALS WORKED VERY HARD AND WELL TO MAKE SURE BALLOTS WERE DELIVERED TIMELY. THEY ARE TO BE COMMENDED FOR OUTSTANDING WORK.

THE BIGGEST CHALLENGE WE FACED DURING THE 2020 GENERAL ELECTION WAS THE USE OF MAILERS FROM SPECIAL INTEREST GROUPS. SEVERAL SPECIAL INTEREST GROUPS USED OUR LOCAL ELECTION ADDRESS ON THE MAILER SO THAT IT APPEARED THE MAILER HAD COME FROM OUR OFFICE. THIS CREATED PROBLEMS WITH MAILER COSTS BEING CHARGED TO OUR COUNTY OFFICE, WITH VOTERS BEING CONFUSED AS TO WHY THEY RECEIVED THE MAILER SINCE THEY HAD ALREADY RESPONDED TO AN ACTUAL OFFICE MAILER THAT WE HAD ALREADY SENT, AND EVEN LED TO MISINFORMATION TO VOTERS AS ONE MAILER HAD NUMEROUS INCORRECT DEADLINES.

IT IS A WONDERFUL THING FOR ORGANIZATIONS AND SPECIAL INTERESTS GROUPS TO BE EXCITED ABOUT VOTING AND TO HELP INCREASE VOTER PARTICIPATION, BUT THOSE POSITIVES QUICKLY TURN TO NEGATIVES IF THE DATA AND DEADLINES THE GROUPS PUBLISH AND DISSEMINATE ARE INCORRECT. WE HAD A SPECIAL INTEREST GROUP IN NEBRASKA THAT SENT OUT ABSENTEE BALLOT APPLICATIONS WITH THE RETURN DATE FOR A MAILED BALLOT LISTED AS A DATE THAT WAS FIVE DAYS AFTER THE ACTUAL DEADLINE. WE DID RECEIVE LATE APPLICATIONS ON THESE MAILERS. OUR OFFICE THEN HAD TO CONTACT ALL THESE VOTERS TO INFORM THEM OF THE IN-PERSON VOTING OPPORTUNITIES THEY STILL HAD SO THEY WOULD NOT BE DISENFRANCHISED.

THERE SHOULD BE PROOFREADING REGULATIONS FOR SUCH MAILERS BY SPECIAL INTEREST GROUPS. IT’S NOT NECESSARILY THE SPECIAL INTEREST GROUPS RESPONSIBILITY TO KNOW ALL THE ELECTION DEADLINES, BUT THEY SHOULD CONSULT WITH ELECTION OFFICIALS (SECRETARY OF STATE OFFICES)  TO MAKE SURE THE CORRECT DATES ARE PUBLISHED SO THAT VOTERS DON’T PAY THE PRICE.

THERE WAS ANOTHER SPECIAL INTEREST GROUP FROM ANOTHER STATE THAT SENT BY-MAIL BALLOT APPLICATIONS, VOTER REGISTRATION FORMS AND MAILERS RAISING QUESTIONS ABOUT WHETHER SOMEONE IN THE HOUSEHOLD WAS NO LONGER REGISTERED TO VOTE. THESE MULTIPLE MAILERS WERE SENT LOCALLY AND CREATED PANIC FOR SOME LONG-TIME VOTERS WHO THEN CALLED OR CAME IN PERSON TO OUR OFFICE. THE CONSTANT MAILERS TO ONE VOTER EVEN RESULTED IN BUILDING FRUSTRATION TO THE POINT THE VOTER SENT A SUSPICIOUS PACKAGE TO OUR OFFICE AND OUR GOVERNMENT BUILDING WAS EVACUATED WHILE LAW ENFORCEMENT BROUGHT IN BOMB TECHNICIANS. THE VOTER WAS ANGRY OVER SOMETHING WE DIDN’T EVEN SEND, YET IT LOOKED LIKE A MAILER FROM OUR OFFICE. AGAIN, GENERATING INTEREST AND PARTICIPATION IN VOTING IS FANTASTIC AND APPRECIATED, BUT IT SHOULD BE DONE WITH ACCURATE INFORMATION AND IN A POSITIVE MANNER.

source_details.f13: IT WAS THE LARGEST NUMBER OF VOTERS IN KNOX COUNTY!  WE REALLY DIDN’T HAVE ANY PROBLEMS AS VOTERS RETURNED THEIR BALLOTS THROUGH THE MAIL, A LARGE NUMBER USED THE DROP BOXES AND A LARGE NUMBER BROUGHT THEIR BALLOTS TO THE OFFICE.  THERE WERE SOME THAT HAD TO BE REJECTED BECAUSE WE CLEARLY COULD PROVE THAT A PARENT SIGNED FOR A COLLEGE STUDENT AND SEVERAL HUSBANDS WANTED TO SIGN THE BALLOT ENVELOPES FOR THEIR WIVES WHO WERE IN NURSING HOMES (COVID ISSUES).  OTHER THAN THAT, OUR BIGGEST THING WAS LEARNING THE NEW EQUIPMENT AND SOFTWARE.  WE HAD THE NEW EQUIPMENT AT THE PRIMARY BUT IT WAS DIFFERENT IN THE GENERAL AS THERE WERE MANY LOCAL WRITE-INS THAT TOOK TIME BUT IT WORKED!!

OUR BIGGEST CHALLENGE WAS SPACE NEEDS AND MAINTAINING SOCIAL DISTANCE REQUIREMENTS DUE TO COVID-19.   WE ENDED UP “RENTING” ADDITIONAL SPACE FROM A NEARBY CHURCH THAT WE ALSO USE AS A POLLING LOCATION FOR OUR EARLY VOTE COUNTING BOARD.

DEFINITELY WAS A LEARNING YEAR WITH THE PRIMARY AND GENERAL ELECTIONS ALONG WITH THE NEW EQUIPMENT. LARGEST PRECINCTS HAD ISSUES WITH LONG LINES AND SHORTAGE OF BALLOTS AS I ORDERED TOO FEW BALLOTS FOR THE LOCATION. WAS ABLE TO MAKE IT WORK WITH EXPRESSVOTES, BUT THIS CONTRIBUTED TO THE LONG LINES AS THERE WAS ONLY ONE AT THE LOCATION. HUMAN ERROR LED TO WIPING OUT AN ELECTION DEFINITION USB INSTEAD OF A RESULTS USB FROM THE LOGIC AND ACCURACY TESTING, SO A BACKUP ELECTION DEFINITION USB HAD TO BE ACQUIRED MAKING IT TAKE LONGER.  OVER ALL, I ENJOYED THE LEARNING PROCESS AND THE INFORMATION I HAVE GAINED FROM THIS YEAR.  VERY THANKFUL TO OUR SOS AND OUR ELECTION VENDORS.

source_details.f13: DURING TRAINING, WE SHOWED A VIDEO MADE BY THE SOS OFFICE ON HOW TO USE THE EXPRESSVOTE.  WE THEN ASKED THE WORKERS TO GO TRY THE MACHINES.  AT FIRST THEY WERE VERY HESITANT TO USE THE MACHINES AS THEY WERE NOT FAMILIAR WITH THEM.  ONCE WE EXPLAINED TO THEM THE MACHINES DO NOT TALLY VOTES AND THEY GOT INTO THE PROGRAM, ALMOST ALL OF THE PEOPLE WERE IMPRESSED WITH THE EASE OF USE OF THE MACHINE.  EVEN THE OLDER WORKERS WHO USED THEM SAID THEY THOUGHT THEY COULD SHOW SOMEONE HOW TO USE THE MACHINE.  WE GOT VERY POSITIVE FEEDBACK ON THIS METHOD.  WE DO WISH THERE WOULD BE AN UPDATED VIDEO ON ELECTION DAY ACTIVITIES AND OTHER INFORMATION ON WHAT PEOPLE DO AS AN ELECTION WORKER (CLERK AND JUDGE DUTIES).  I DO WISH THERE WAS AN EASIER WAY TO GET PEOPLE TO USE THE MACHINES.  MOST PEOPLE ARE AFRAID TO USE THE MACHINES BECAUSE THEY ARE NOT FAMILIAR WITH THEM.

OVERALL, I AM PLEASED WITH THE ELECTION. THERE WAS A NOTICEABLE DIFFERENCE AT ONE OF THE POLLING LOCATIONS THAT HOLD ELECTIONS FOR FOUR PRECINCTS AND A “USUAL” DIRECTOR OF TRAFFIC WAS UNABLE TO WORK FOR THE FIRST TIME IN MANY, MANY YEARS DUE TO COVID.

WHEN COUNTING, I DIDN’T CARE WHEN THE 450 SCANNER WOULD TOSS A BALLOT OUT BECAUSE OF A SLIGHT MARK IN AN OVAL.  I RAN IT THROUGH SEVERAL TIMES AND THEN HAD TO RE-MARK IT OVER 100 OF THEM!   I KNOW OTHER CLERK’S HAD THE SAME PROBLEM.    I DON’T THINK I SHOULD BE MAKING THE DECISION OF WHICH OVAL SHOULD BE MARKED.  I BELIEVE THAT THE BALLOT SHOULD BE COUNTED AND THAT RACE WITH AN EXTRA SLIGHT MARK, SHOULD BE COUNTED AS AN OVER VOTE.  I FELT LIKE I WAS HAVING TO MAKE A DECISION THAT WE AREN’T SUPPOSED TO MAKE.

source_details.f1comments: CALCULATIONS BASED ON THE RECORDS OF PREVIOUS CLERK.  F1B-F1H ADD TO 17,086.  THE MISTAKE MAY BE IN F1B AS THERE IS NO WAY TO CROSSCHECK THAT DATA.  IT IS SOLELY BASED ON THE PRECINCT CANVASSING WORKSHEET DATA WHICH IS HANDWRITTEN. F1F IS # REPORTED IN SV
source_details.f12comments: DS200 MACHINES TABULATE VOTES AT EACH PRECINCT - DATA IS THEN STORED ON SECURE FLASH DRIVES AND TRANSPORTED TO A CENTRAL LOCATION FOR ENTRY INTO ELECTION REPORTING SOFTWARE.
F12B. VOTERS WITH DISABILITIES VOTE ON SAME EQUIPMENT AS ALL IN PERSON VOTERS AND BALLOTS ARE NOT DISTINGUISHED.

source_details.f12comments: MASON COUNTY'S CENTRAL COUNTING LOCATION IS AT THE COUNTY COURTHOUSE

source_details.f1comments: AT THE TIME OF THE 2020 GENERAL ELECTION BASED ON MY RECORDS, THE TOTAL VOTER REGISTRATION NUMBER IN PLEASANTS COUNTY, WV WAS 5,455 VOTERS. I CANNOT ACCESS SECTION A1A. SO I CANNOT SEE WHAT THAT TOTAL WOULD BE. I AM COMPLETING THIS WITH THE NUMBERS I HAVE
source_details.f12comments: ALL BALLOTS ARE SCANNED AT PRECINCTS ON ELECTION DAY BUT ARE TALLIED AT THE PLEASANTS COUNTY COURTHOUSE ON ELECTION NIGHT.
source_details.f13: NO IRREGULARITIES OR ANOMALIES OCCURRED IN PLEASANTS COUNTY, WV ON ELECTION DAY 2020.
